name: medibid-ai
description: MediBid AI — Intelligent Hyperlocal Pharmacy Marketplace

scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,cyan" "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000" "cd frontend && npm start -- -p 3000"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,cyan" "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
